name: c-di-GMP riboswitch bound to cyclic di-GMP (C2E)
notes: c-di-GMP riboswitch aptamer (GEMM-I class) from Clostridium acetobutylicum at 2.70 Å. C2E is cyclic-di-GMP (MW ~690, 2 P atoms). Both guanine bases stack on receptor nucleobases; pyrophosphate bridges contact backbone P. IRI (iridium hexamine, phasing agent) and GTP stripped from receptor. Mg retained. Exercises ligand-P term (2P), stacking (2 guanine rings), phosphate. Ref: Kang et al. 2012 PNAS.
